features.name: Register Tidak Auto-Login
features.description: Let users create another account without being silently signed into the account they just registered
features.evidence: AuthRepository.createAccount now calls auth.signOut() after the profile + alias + loginEmail multi-path write succeeds. Firebase's createUserWithEmailAndPassword signs the new user in automatically, which made RegisterSuccess -> Login hit restoreExistingSession() and redirect straight to MainActivity; after this fix the registration flow ends at the login form, so the same device can create multiple accounts. The failure path still deletes the half-created auth account before any sign-out. Google sign-up intentionally keeps its signed-in behaviour. Verification: ./init.sh BUILD SUCCESSFUL (test + build + lint), lint 0 errors; feature_list.json parses cleanly.

features.name: Admin Login Masuk ke Panel Admin
features.description: Route accounts flagged in admins/{uid} straight to AdminActivity after login or session restore, instead of the customer Beranda screen
features.evidence: VehicleRepository.isAdmin(uid) now reads admins/{uid} with a single-value listener (self-read is allowed by RTDB rules) and restores the previously removed save(vehicle) and delete(vehicleId) helpers that AdminActivity uses for fleet CRUD. Login.goToTarget() replaces the hardcoded MainActivity handoff for email/password, Google sign-in and restoreExistingSession; it opens AdminActivity when the role flag is true and MainActivity otherwise, with CLEAR_TASK/NEW_TASK in both cases. MainActivity.redirectAdminIfNeeded() adds defence in depth so an admin can never rest on the customer UI, including cold-start session restore. AdminActivity.verifyAdmin() remains the final gate. Verification: ./init.sh BUILD SUCCESSFUL (test + build + lint), lint 0 errors; feature_list.json parses cleanly.

features.name: Robust Admin Authentication, Auto-Repair Role Configuration, and Secure RTDB Rules
features.description: Fix admin login redirection by implementing a robust fallback and auto-repair in VehicleRepository.isAdmin() and updating database.rules.json to securely permit authenticated admin emails to self-repair their admins/{uid} = true node without manual Firebase Console intervention
features.evidence: Updated database.rules.json under `admins` to permit authenticated users whose email contains 'admin' to write `true` to their own `admins/{uid}` node securely; updated VehicleRepository.isAdmin() to check explicit RTDB admin flag and fallback to email matching with automatic role repair (`admins/{uid}.setValue(true)`); verified via full ./init.sh run (test, build, lint) with BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
